---
name: Extraction problem
about: A figure that ReSrijan reads wrongly or not at all
labels: extraction
---

**Command**
```
resrijan digitize ...
```

**What went wrong** (wrong values, missing series, crash, …)

**Files** – please attach (only what you may share):
- [ ] the figure (or a re-drawn equivalent)
- [ ] `*_report.html` and `*_overlay.png`
- [ ] correct values, if known

**Environment**: `resrijan --version`, Ubuntu version, `tesseract --version | head -1`
